The documentation states: "Spindle bearing has reached catastrophic failure threshold. Vibration RMS on spindle exceeds 11.2 mm/s with kurtosis index >20. Continued operation risks spindle shaft damage and workpiece ejection." [SOURCE: SPN-CR-001 chunk SPN-CR-001__0000]

This is the highest severity classification, as it indicates:
- **Immediate risk**: Continued operation risks spindle shaft damage and workpiece ejection
- **Critical action required**: The remedy mandates immediate spindle bearing replacement and acceptance testing before production restart [SOURCE: SPN-CR-001 chunk SPN-CR-001__0000]

# Error AXS-CR-001: Axis Following Error — Emergency Stop

## Definition / Meaning
Error AXS-CR-001 indicates an **Axis Following Error that has triggered an Emergency Stop condition**. The following error P016 exceeds the emergency stop threshold of 2.0 mm, causing all axes to halt immediately. Position integrity cannot be guaranteed after this error occurs [SOURCE: AXS-CR-001 chunk AXS-CR-001__0000].

## Root Cause
The probable causes for this error are:
- Drive fault
- Ball screw failure
- Axis collision
- Encoder loss

[SOURCE: AXS-CR-001 chunk AXS-CR-001__0000]

## Diagnostic Information
When this error occurs, the system reports:
- P016 = following error value (in mm)
- P010, P011, P012 = position errors on individual axes (in mm)

[SOURCE: AXS-CR-001 chunk AXS-CR-001__0000]

## Remediation
1. Identify which axis has faulted
2. Repair the mechanical cause (drive, ball screw, collision damage, or encoder)
3. Re-home all axes before resuming operation

[SOURCE: AXS-CR-001 chunk AXS-CR-001__0000]

Based on the provided context chunks, the following are CRITICAL severity error codes for the spindle subsystem:

1. **SPN-CR-001: Spindle Bearing Catastrophic Failure**
   - Vibration RMS on spindle exceeds 11.2 mm/s with kurtosis index >20
   - Risk of spindle shaft damage and workpiece ejection
   - Remedy: Replace spindle bearing set and run acceptance test SPD-TEST-001 [SOURCE: SPN-CR-001 chunk SPN-CR-001__0000]

2. **SPN-CR-002: Spindle Drive Overcurrent — Hard Fault**
   - Spindle drive current exceeded 145% of rated value for more than 200ms
   - Drive has tripped on hardware overcurrent protection
   - Remedy: Replace faulty drive module or motor depending on fault localization [SOURCE: SPN-CR-002 chunk SPN-CR-002__0000]

3. **SPN-CR-003: Spindle Orientation Failure — Tool Change Blocked**
   - Spindle failed to reach orientation position within timeout (5 s)
   - Orientation error exceeds ±0.5 deg limit
   - Tool change cycle aborted to prevent ATC arm collision
   - Remedy: Replace encoder or repair signal cable, then re-run tool change acceptance cycle TCS-TEST-002 [SOURCE: SPN-CR-003 chunk SPN-CR-003__0000]

# Diagnostic Steps for LUB-CR-001

**Definition / Meaning:**
Lubrication System Failure — Machine Stopped. The lubrication oil pressure P040 is below the critical minimum threshold of 0.5 bar, indicating a critical system failure that has halted the machine [SOURCE: LUB-CR-001 chunk LUB-CR-001__0000].

**Root Cause:**
The probable causes are:
- Lubrication pump failure
- Empty reservoir
- Blocked distributor

[SOURCE: LUB-CR-001 chunk LUB-CR-001__0000]

**Diagnostic Steps:**
1. **Verify current system status**: Check oil pressure P040 and oil level P041 to confirm the failure condition [SOURCE: LUB-CR-001 chunk LUB-CR-001__0000]

2. **Do NOT restart the machine** without verified lube pressure restoration [SOURCE: LUB-CR-001 chunk LUB-CR-001__0000]

**Remediation:**
1. Restore the lubrication system by addressing the root cause (pump failure, refilling reservoir, or clearing blockage) [SOURCE: LUB-CR-001 chunk LUB-CR-001__0000]

2. After restoration, jog all axes 100mm to distribute oil before resuming production [SOURCE: LUB-CR-001 chunk LUB-CR-001__0000]

**Critical Note:** Continued operation without lubrication will cause rapid guide and ball screw wear [SOURCE: LUB-CR-001 chunk LUB-CR-001__0000].
The normal range for parameter P002 Spindle Load is **0 – 85%** [SOURCE: DOC-EIQ-002_Spindle_Drive_System chunk DOC-EIQ-002_Spindle_Drive_System__0003]

## Common Investigation Approach

Across multiple cases, investigators used consistent diagnostic methods:

- **Vibration Data Analysis**: Reviewed dominant frequencies and compared them to tooth-passing frequencies to identify chatter patterns [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2050 chunk CMP-SYN-2050__0000]
- **Stability Lobe Diagram Analysis**: Determined whether the operating point was in an unstable region [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2050 chunk CMP-SYN-2050__0000]
- **Crest Factor & Kurtosis Measurement**: Used crest factor values consistent with regenerative chatter (rather than bearing defects) to confirm root cause [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2009 chunk CMP-SYN-2009__0000]

## Root Cause Findings

**Process Parameter Issues**: Most cases identified chatter as stemming from process parameter selection rather than machine defects [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2050 chunk CMP-SYN-2050__0000] [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2029 chunk CMP-SYN-2029__0000]

**Mechanical Contributing Factors**: One case (M03) identified two independent mechanical causes: toolholder taper fretting corrosion and a hydraulic circuit leak reducing clamping force from 70 bar to 4 bar [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2012 chunk CMP-SYN-2012__0000]

## Remediation Approaches

- Spindle speed adjustments (typically ±200 RPM shifts) to move to adjacent stable lobes [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2050 chunk CMP-SYN-2050__0000]
- Variable pitch tooling implementation (4-flute, pitch 30/32/34/36°) [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2050 chunk CMP-SYN-2050__0000]
- Reduction of axial depth of cut by 20% [SOURCE: CMP-SYN-2009 chunk CMP-SYN-2009__0000]

# Error Code SPN-MJ-002: Definition and Resolution

## Definition / Meaning

**SPN-MJ-002** is a **MAJOR severity** error code titled "Spindle Bearing Vibration — Major Threshold Exceeded" [SOURCE: DOC-EIQ-002_Spindle_Drive_System chunk DOC-EIQ-002_Spindle_Drive_System__0004]. The required action is to "Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production" [SOURCE: DOC-EIQ-002_Spindle_Drive_System chunk DOC-EIQ-002_Spindle_Drive_System__0004].

## Root Cause

Based on field cases, SPN-MJ-002 typically indicates **bearing fatigue from operation beyond the grease service interval**. In a documented case, a spindle bearing had been in service for 4,183 hours, exceeding the OEM limit of 4,000 hours, resulting in outer race spalling on a 7014 bearing with a defect frequency component confirmed at BPFO = 96.0 Hz [SOURCE: CMP-2019-1007 chunk CMP-2019-1007__0000].

## Diagnostic Steps

Field engineers have performed the following diagnostics:

- **Vibration measurement**: Recorded P004 (vibration velocity) readings; in the documented case, P004 = 6.68 mm/s at time of fault (ISO Zone B) [SOURCE: CMP-2019-1007 chunk CMP-2019-1007__0000]
- **Kurtosis analysis**: Measured P064 (Kurtosis Index); a value of 4.1 confirmed defect frequency components [SOURCE: CMP-2019-1007 chunk CMP-2019-1007__0000]
- **Physical inspection**: Removed spindle nose cap and inspected bearings for visible spalling or pitting [SOURCE: CMP-2019-1045 chunk CMP-2019-1045__0000]

## Remediation

**Bearing replacement** is the primary resolution:
- Replace spindle bearing set with OEM-specified parts (e.g., 2× 7014 CDBP4 angular contact bearings and 1× NU1014 rear bearing) [SOURCE: CMP-2019-1007 chunk CMP-2019-1007__0000]
- Install bearings with correct preload per EIQ-PROC-SPN-001 [SOURCE: CMP-2019-1007 chunk CMP-2019-1007__0000]
- Warm up spindle per SPD-WARMUP-001 (15 minutes) [SOURCE: CMP-2019-1007 chunk CMP-2019-1007__0000]
- Run acceptance vibration test; in the documented case, post-repair P004 = 2.20 mm/s (Zone A — pass) [SOURCE: CMP-2019-1007 chunk CMP-2019-1007__0000]
